title: Prophylactic Effect of Memantine in Chronic Tension-Type Headache
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test whether memantine has a prophylactic effect on chronic tension-type headaches.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronic tension-type headache
* Normal urine pH

Exclusion Criteria:

* More than 1 migraine attack/month
* Other major illnesses
* Overuse of medicine/alcohol
* Women not using AC
* Pregnant/breast-feeding women
* Allergy to memantine
